jobs.title: Senior Manager, Global Treasury Architecture, Systems & Processes
jobs.location: EMEA > CHE > Stabio > VF Campus VF1
jobs.description:
VF Corporation is looking for an exceptional Senior Manager, Global Treasury Architecture, Systems & Processes to join our Treasury team based in Stabio, Switzerland.

Let’s talk about the role!
Reporting to the Director, Treasury EMEA, the Senior Manager, Global Treasury Architecture, Systems & Processes owns the global functional roadmap, further rollout, optimization, and governance of all global treasury systems and connected treasury processes. The role translates Treasury strategy and operational needs into scalable system capabilities, globally consistent processes, effective controls, and measurable business outcomes.

The position acts as the primary bridge between Global Treasury, Digital Technology, Controllership, Tax, internal controls, banking partners, technology providers, and implementation partners to maintain and enhance Global Treasury capabilities, support ongoing technology initiatives, improve operational efficiency, and ensure globally consistent treasury processes and controls. It leads complex Treasury technology and process enhancement initiatives from requirements and solution design through testing, deployment, adoption, stabilization, and continuous improvement.

How you'll make a difference
Global Treasury Technologies Strategy, Product Ownership & Governance
- Own and maintain the global Treasury technology roadmap, prioritizing initiatives according to business value, risk, control requirements, dependencies, and available resources.

- Act as Treasury functional owner for Kyriba and related treasury applications, managing the enhancement backlog, release priorities, decision forums, and escalation paths.

- Define global design principles, process standards, governance, roles, and responsibilities while managing justified regional or regulatory requirements.

- Partner with Digital Technology on application lifecycle, architecture, integrations, access governance, change management, incidents, support ownership, and vendor oversight.

- Monitor system usage, service quality, operational resilience, and value realization; establish transparent KPIs and report progress, risks, decisions, and benefits to Treasury leadership.

Global Treasury Systems Delivery and Optimization
- Evaluate opportunities to improve automation, operational efficiency, reporting capabilities, and system utilization.

- Lead further global rollout of treasury system capabilities across regions, legal entities, banks, and Treasury processes, including structured scope, roadmap, milestones, resources, risks, and dependencies.

- Serve as lead treasury subject matter expert on cross functional team projects impacting treasury systems.

- Lead discovery and design workshops, document business and functional requirements, challenge unnecessary customization, and promote scalable standard solutions.

- Coordinate configuration, data preparation and migration, bank connectivity, interfaces, testing, cutover, hypercare, and operational handover with regional teams and external partners.

- Develop testing strategies and coordinate unit, integration, user acceptance, regression, and parallel testing; ensure defects are prioritized, resolved, documented, and approved before deployment.

- Ensure implementations are controlled, auditable, and designed to avoid disruption to payments, cash visibility, reconciliation, accounting, FX, cash and debt forecasting and month-end processes.

Process Standardization, Automation & Controls
- Lead end-to-end review and redesign of global Treasury processes, eliminating manual workarounds, simplifying handoffs, clarifying ownership, and embedding effective controls.

- Drive automation across bank statements, payments, cash accounting, reconciliations, liquidity reporting, forecasting, financial risk management, and Treasury reporting.

- Partner with Treasury operations and Controllership to standardize accounting interfaces, posting logic, exception management, reconciliations, and control evidence.

- Ensure system and process changes comply with Treasury policies, segregation-of-duties principles, internal controls, Sarbanes-Oxley requirements, information-security standards, and audit expectations.

- Maintain global process documentation, solution designs, configuration records, control narratives, test evidence, operating procedures.

Data, Reporting & Integration
- Improve Treasury data quality, ownership, and consistency across Kyriba, ERP platforms (S4 Hana and Central Finance), banks, market-data sources, and connected applications.

- Develop a global reporting and analytics framework that provides timely, reliable insight into liquidity, cash, debt, investments, FX, counterparty exposure, process performance.

- Develop global reporting for global long-term forecasting with flexibility to manage alternative scenarios.

- Lead Treasury functional requirements for integrations, file formats, bank connectivity, APIs, interfaces, and reporting solutions, including ISO 20022 and CAMT adoption where relevant.

- Establish monitoring and reconciliation mechanisms that identify incomplete, duplicate, rejected, or inconsistent data and support timely resolution.

Adoption, Capability Building
- Own the global adoption and knowledge-transfer approach, including stakeholder engagement, communications, training, user documentation, super-user networks, and post-go-live support.

- Build internal Treasury capability so that routine functional support, reporting, configuration knowledge, and process ownership are progressively retained in-house.

- Manage working relationships with Kyriba, banks, consultants, and other service providers; challenge scope, quality, delivery, cost, and dependency on external support.

- Facilitate global user forums to collect pain points, share best practices, align priorities, and sustain consistent ways of working across regions.

- Provide functional leadership, coaching, and direction to project resources and workstream owners without relying on formal reporting lines.

Skills for Success
- At least 8 years of progressive experience in corporate Treasury, Treasury technology, finance transformation, banking technology, or treasury advisory, with significant responsibility for global or multi-region initiatives.

- Demonstrated experience implementing, rolling out, enhancing, or supporting a Treasury Management System. Hands-on Kyriba experience is strongly preferred.

- Strong understanding of Treasury processes, including cash and liquidity management, payments, bank connectivity, cash accounting, short term and long term forecasting, FX and risk management, controls, and reporting.

- Experience leading complex projects across Treasury, Finance, Digital Technology, banks, and external implementation partners from design through stabilization.

- Working knowledge of ERP and integration concepts, file-based and API connectivity, ISO 20022 formats, data controls, testing methodologies, and system change governance.

- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, Information Systems, or a related field. A recognized Treasury, project-management, or Kyriba certification is an advantage.

- Fluent English, spoken and written. Additional languages are an advantage in a global environment.

- Global process ownership and systems thinking

- Technology delivery and disciplined project execution

- Ability to translate Treasury requirements into scalable technology solutions

- Strong stakeholder management, facilitation, influence, and executive communication

- Control mindset, attention to detail, and sound operational judgment

- Analytical problem solving and structured prioritization

- Change management, training, and user adoption

- Commercial management of vendors and implementation partners

- Self-starter able to manage multiple priorities in a complex global environment

What’s in it For You
We’re in the business of unleashing human potential, driven by the ideas, energy and commitment of our people. That’s why we offer comprehensive benefits that encourage mental, physical and financial well-being for all VF associates. When it comes to benefits, we’re the total package.
- A supportive feedback-based culture where respect and integrity guide us in what we do
- An inclusive international environment where people of diverse backgrounds, lifestyles and nationalities love working together
- Be part of an iconic lifestyle brand in a multi brand, multi countries organization
- On site gym offering health and well-being initiatives
- A discount card with 50% on all VF brands
- Break out areas offering complimentary hot drinks

Free to Be, Inclusion & Diversity
As an equal opportunity employer, we strive to foster a culture of belonging based on respect, connection, openness and authenticity. We are committed to building and maintaining a workplace that celebrates the diversity of our associates, allowing them to bring their authentic selves to work every day.

If you like what you have read and want to join our team then we would like to hear from you!

A day in the life of a Project Manager, Transformation at VF looks a little like this.

Project Manager, Transformation – provides hands-on support to the Senior Director of Transformation, VP of Transformation, and leadership in GTM and Commercial Functions. Specific responsibilities include oversight and cross-functional implementation of transformation workstreams, support on required tool and process development, and change management with a special focus on AI and Gen AI in marketing, creative, product and content creation and related builds and analytics. In doing so, this role will work closely with the respective functions (marketing, creative, ecom / DTC, design, product development, etc.) across brands as well as with the VF Innovation team.
Let’s break down that day-in-the-life a bit more.

- Workstream Execution with focus on AI & GenAI Acceleration – e.g., digital, creative, and marketing asset creation, product creation, etc. - Work closely together with the Innovation team to drive implementation and value delivery of AI / Gen AI use cases where technology is mature enough to be scaled across the enterprise

- Ability to project manage multiple cross-brand initiatives and highly organized to ensure continued progress.
- Influencer – the ability to inspire and persuade others without relying on formal authority.

At Timberland, we’re a force of nature. We’re a team that steps outside, works hard together, and moves the world forward. The brand is widely recognized as the arbiter of boot culture. With a rich heritage of craftsmanship and an eye toward the future, Timberland has a decades-long commitment to make products responsibly, protect the outdoors, and build community.

So, before we get to the job details, take a minute to learn a little more about us – our values and our culture. If you can see yourself working side-by-side with an team of fun, adventure-loving people, Timberland just may be the place for you.

To learn more about our values and our culture, visit Timberland Careers or www.timberland.com.

What will you do?

A day in the life of a Senior Manager, FP&A - Wholesale Americas at Timberland

As the Senior Manager, FP&A for Wholesale Americas, you will serve as the finance leader and strategic business partner for Timberland's Wholesale business across the region. You will play a critical role in shaping business decisions, driving financial performance, and providing visibility into risks and opportunities that impact the channel's growth and profitability.
You will partner closely with the Wholesale leadership team and cross-functional business partners to translate strategy into financial outcomes, deliver actionable insights, and drive accountability across the organization. This role requires a combination of strong financial acumen, commercial mindset, leadership, and the ability to influence decision-making in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.

Let's break down that day-in-the-life a bit more:
- Serve as the primary finance business partner to the Americas Wholesale leadership team, providing financial guidance and strategic insight to support business decisions and drive profitable growth.
- Lead the Wholesale Americas strategic plan, annual operating plan, monthly forecasts, and in-season business updates.
- Own the end-to-end financial performance review process for the Wholesale business, including revenue, gross margin, SG&A, operating income, working capital, and cash flow.
- Deliver timely and insightful analysis of business performance, identifying key drivers, emerging risks, and opportunities to improve financial outcomes.
- Drive accountability through business reviews and performance management processes, ensuring financial commitments and business objectives remain aligned.
- Lead the regional in-season forecasting process, providing clear visibility into demand trends, customer performance, financial outlook, and key business assumptions.
- Partner closely with Commercial, Merchandising, Demand Planning, Operations, and Brand teams to evaluate opportunities, investments, and strategic initiatives.
- Support customer and market-level decision-making through financial analysis and scenario planning.
- Identify and implement processes, systems, and reporting improvements that enhance forecasting accuracy, operational efficiency, and business insights.
- Lead and develop a high-performing team while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
- Ensure compliance with internal controls, financial policies, and reporting requirements.
- Provide ad hoc financial analysis and executive-level decision support on strategic initiatives and special projects.

What do you need to succeed?
We are looking for a highly analytical, commercially minded finance leader who combines strong financial expertise with the ability to influence decisions, challenge assumptions, and partner effectively across the organization.

The foundation skills you will need in this position are:
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.
- 8+ years of progressive finance experience, including significant experience in FP&A, Commercial Finance, or business-facing finance leadership roles.
- Proven track record of partnering with senior business leaders to drive decision-making and deliver financial results.
- Strong understanding of financial planning, forecasting, performance management, and P&L ownership.
- Demonstrated ability to lead complex planning processes while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
- Exceptional business partnering and influencing skills, with the ability to challenge constructively and build credibility across all levels of the organization.
- Strong leadership experience with a passion for developing talent and building high-performing teams.

jobs.title: Analyst, Strategy & Global Allocation, Apparel
jobs.location: ASIA > SGP > Singapore > GMT Product Supply Office
jobs.description:
About the Role
We're hiring an Analyst to help bring our global allocation strategy to life. You will work closely with the Allocation Senior Manager and cross-functional partners across Sourcing Development, Supply Planning, Materials Sourcing, Costing, and Product Development to turn pre-season and in-season allocation plans into action. This is a hands-on role where you will spend most of your time gathering and analyzing data, building reports, and shaping recommendations that guide allocation decisions, with a clear view of how those decisions impact downstream teams and processes. It is a strong fit for someone who wants to build deep expertise in sourcing and see their day-to-day work create visible business impact.
What You'll Do
- Drive data gathering, analysis, and reporting to support pre-season and in-season allocation decisions, turning insights into actionable recommendations for cross-functional stakeholders
- Build reports and visualizations in Excel, Tableau, and/or Power BI that generate insights and enable effective decision-making.
- Assess cross-functional dependencies and downstream impacts to develop allocation recommendations that are well-informed, aligned, and executable.
- Partner with teams across Sourcing Development, Supply Planning, Materials Sourcing, Costing, and Product Development to gather inputs, align stakeholders, and support allocation decisions
- Proactively identify information gaps, validate assumptions, and drive closure on open questions to support timely and sound decision-making.
- Support the Allocation Senior Manager in executing allocation strategies and translating plans into effective operational actions.

What Success Looks Like
- Allocation plans are executed accurately and on schedule.
- Allocation processes run smoothly, with risks and issues flagged early.
- Data and reporting are clear, timely, and actionable for stakeholders.
- Cross-functional partners see you as a reliable, responsive, and proactive point of contact.

Required Skills & Experience
- Undergraduate degree in any field.
- Experience in operations, procurement, supply chain, business analysis, or a related analytical role is advantageous; fresh graduates with strong analytical capabilities are encouraged to apply.
- Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, pivot tables, and data cleanup.
- Working knowledge of at least one data visualization tool, such as Tableau or Power BI.
- Clear written and verbal communication skills in English.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail.
- Comfortable managing multiple stakeholders, priorities, and deadlines at once.
- Strong systems thinking and business judgment, with the ability to evaluate interdependencies and translate insights into actionable recommendations.
- Resourceful and proactive in identifying information gaps, validating assumptions, and following through to support sound decision-making.
- Intellectually curious and eager to learn, with the ability to quickly build understanding across unfamiliar business processes and datasets.

Nice to Have (Not Required)
- Exposure to Power Query.
- Familiarity with data and/or document automation tools such as KNIME or Alteryx.
- Prior exposure to sourcing, supply chain, or global trend analysis, helpful but not expected on day one.

jobs.description:
Vans is the original brand rooted in the authentic lifestyle of skateboarding. We are driven by our mission to inspire and empower everyone to live “Off The Wall” – embracing the youthful spirit of freedom, non-conformity, and relentless progression. Yesterday’s “Off The Wall” moment is today’s new normal, and at Vans, we believe in constantly outdoing ourselves. Together with our communities across the globe, our vision is to push culture forward because we believe that the pursuit of progression never ends. We are constantly inspired by the future generation of positive catalysts within our community.

So, before we get to the job details, take a minute to learn a little more about us – our values and our culture. If you can see yourself working side-by-side with a team of people who think and live “Off the Wall,” Vans just may be the place for you.

To learn more about our values and our culture, visit Vans Careers or www.vans.com .

What will you do?
A day in the life of a Director, FP&A at Vans looks a little like this.

As the Financial Planning & Analysis Director, you serve as a critical partner to the Americas executive leadership team within the brand, providing strategic financial leadership to the executive team and overseeing all financial operations with full P&L responsibility. The role is responsible to drive brand decisions through actionable insights/analytics, holding the executive team accountable for the financial impact of the decision, and steering brand choices towards initiatives with the highest return of investments for the brand, as well as ensuring a balanced approach to drive profitability across multiple channels and different countries in the Americas region. This role will report to brand finance leader and will lead and mentor a team of individuals with roles supporting all areas of the P&L and across channels. In order to succeed this individual will leverage deep understanding of the business and exceptional abilities to partner across all functions of the organization.

Let’s break down that day-in-the-life a bit more.

- Lead pricing and open-to-buy (inventory) processes, supporting merchandising (global and regional) through the go-to-market process and supply and demand planning in identifying opportunities to maximize at the same time the financial impact and the business potential.
- Lead the FP&A function in the brand and the development of operating plans, financial objectives and key metrics for the Forecast, Plan and Long-Range Planning (3 year rolling plan), translating business strategies and merchandising plans into financial goals and outcomes.
- Ensure all budget information is in a systematic format that all functions can understand, through financial reporting which includes dynamic dashboards, business analysis, financial statements, KPI reporting, analysis of key business trends and comprehensive executive level explanations of differences, and query to ensure comprehensive and internal consistency.
- Create a culture of FP&A excellence where the function plays as a strategic partner on financial matters, providing guidance and assistance to all functional groups as needed, in full collaboration with the Brand Regional GM.
- Direct the preparation of Quarterly Business Reviews with VF’s senior executive leadership team.
- Lead, coach, inspire and drive efficiency in a team of finance professionals maintaining an environment of continual improvement, ensuring excellent business partnership across all levels of the organization and a high degree of forecast accuracy.
- Work as a key point of contact between Corporate – Region – Brand to ensure actual and forecasting requirements and deadlines are met.

What do you need to succeed?
We all have unique skills that we bring to work and celebrate every day. For this role, there are foundation skills you’ll need to succeed and excel. Additionally, while formal education in a related field is great to have, we are most interested in your 10+ years of experience and professional achievements.

- Strong financial background with in-depth understanding of business dynamics across different channels: wholesale, retail and outlet stores, digital marketplaces and owned e-com platforms
- Strategic thinker and excellent problem-solving skills with demonstrated ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts and draw valid conclusions

jobs.title: Senior Manager, AI Enablement Enterprise FP&A
jobs.location: USCA > USA > Colorado > Denver HQ - VFC
jobs.description:
At VF, we strive to foster a culture of belonging based on respect, connection, openness, and authenticity.  So, before we get to the job details, take a minute to learn a little more about us – our values and our culture - visit  VF Careers  or  www.vfc.com .

What will you do?

A day in the life of a Senior Manager, AI Enablement Enterprise FP&A at VF looks a little like this.

As the Sr. Manager, AI Enablement, Enterprise FP&A, you will serve as the subject matter expert who turns artificial intelligence capability into working solutions for the Enterprise FP&A organization. Partnering directly with the VP, Enterprise FP&A, you will execute the AI projects prioritized by finance leadership, taking each from requirements through prototype, deployment, and adoption in close partnership with Digital Technology (DT). Equally important, you will bring the team along, building AI literacy and hands-on capability across FP&A so that these tools become part of how the organization works rather than the specialty of one person. This is an individual contributor role that delivers through hands-on building, teaching, and influence across brands, regions, and the enterprise.

Let’s break down that day-in-the-life a bit more.
AI Project Execution and Delivery
- Execute AI projects prioritized by the VP, Enterprise FP&A and finance leadership, owning delivery from requirements through deployment and adoption

- Translate FP&A business problems into clear solution requirements, scope, and success measures, and manage each project to committed timelines

- Partner with DT on architecture, data access, integration, security review, and the path from prototype to supported production solution

- Manage project workstreams across planning, forecasting, variance analysis, management reporting, and business partnering use cases

- Provide regular status updates on progress, risks, dependencies, and decisions required, escalating issues promptly

- Measure and report realized results after deployment, and recommend where solutions should be extended, adjusted, or retired

Solution Design and Hands-On Build
- Design and build working prototypes that demonstrate value quickly, including AI-assisted analysis, narrative generation, document and data extraction, and agentic workflows

- Test and validate AI outputs, including accuracy checks, benchmarking against current process baselines, and ongoing performance monitoring

- Develop and maintain prompt libraries, reusable components, and process documentation so solutions can be extended by others

- Troubleshoot issues with deployed solutions and coordinate resolution with DT and vendors as required

Capability Sharing and Team Enablement
- Build AI literacy across Enterprise FP&A through training sessions, office hours, playbooks, demonstrations, and hands-on coaching tailored to finance workflows

- Share new tools, techniques, and practical use cases with the team as capabilities evolve, translating what is possible into what is useful for FP&A

- Cultivate and support a network of champions and power users across brands and regions to extend capability beyond a single individual

- Drive adoption of deployed solutions, monitoring usage, gathering feedback, and addressing capability gaps and resistance

- Communicate wins, lessons learned, and practical guidance to finance leadership and teams in clear, non-technical terms

Governance Adherence and Data Readiness
- Deliver all solutions in compliance with VF AI usage standards, information security requirements, and internal control expectations

- Apply required human-in-the-loop review protocols and maintain documentation and audit trails for AI-assisted outputs used in reporting

- Surface risks encountered during delivery, including data privacy, confidentiality, model accuracy, and over-reliance, to DT, Internal Controls, and finance leadership

- Identify where data quality, structure, or access limits what AI can deliver, and partner with the appropriate owners on remediation

What do you need to succeed?

We all have unique skills that we bring to work and celebrate every day. For this role, there are foundation skills you’ll need to succeed and excel. Additionally, while formal education in a related field is great to have, we are most interested in your 7+ years of experience and professional achievements.

The foundation skills you will need in this position are:
- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related field preferred

- Seven or more years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance transformation, finance systems, or analytics, with demonstrated depth in leveraging technology (specifically AI) to improve processes; demonstrated capability is weighted more heavily than years of experience

- Strong working knowledge of core FP&A processes, including budgeting, forecasting, long range planning, and management reporting

- Hands-on experience building with generative AI, including prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented approaches, and agentic or automated workflows; practical fluency matters more than formal credentials

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Supply Chain FP&A – Global Adjustments to Standards
jobs.location: EMEA > CHE > Stabio > VF Campus VF1
jobs.description:
VF Corporation is looking for an exceptional Senior Manager, Supply Chain FP&A – Global Adjustments to Standards to join our team based in Stabio, Switzerland.

Let’s talk about the role!
The Senior Manager, Supply Chain FP&A – Global Adjustments to Standards is a strategic finance leader responsible for driving global visibility, governance, forecasting, and decision support for adjustments to gross margin across brands, regions, and commercial channels.

This role owns the financial framework for key margin drivers including tariffs, duties, freight, inventory adjustments, overhead, reserves, product cost changes, and other margin-related adjustments. The Senior Manager partners closely with Regional Finance, Brand Finance, Supply Chain, Sourcing, Product, Controllership, Enterprise FP&A, and executive leadership to ensure margin assumptions are accurate, risks and opportunities are clearly understood, and financial decisions support profitable growth.

How you'll make a difference

Primary Accountabilities:
- Lead global FP&A ownership for adjustments to margin, including planning, forecasting, reporting, governance, and executive-level analysis across brands and regions.
- Develop a clear global framework for margin adjustment accounts, ensuring consistent definitions, assumptions, reporting treatment, and performance narratives.
- Partner with Brand Finance, Regional Finance, Supply Chain, Sourcing, Product, Controllership, and Enterprise FP&A to align margin assumptions and quantify financial impacts.
- Oversee analysis of tariffs, duties, inbound freight, logistics costs, overhead, inventory adjustments, product cost changes, reserves, reclasses, and other gross margin impacts.
- Translate complex margin movements into executive-ready insights, financial bridges, scenario analyses, risk assessments, and recommended actions.
- Drive quarterly forecasts, annual budget, long-range planning, and strategic plan inputs for global margin adjustment activity.
- Identify risks, opportunities, and root causes of margin variance; partner with stakeholders to support mitigation plans and improve forecast accuracy.
- Lead, coach, and develop global Analysts and Senior Analysts supporting AGM, building capability in financial modelling, business partnership, process improvement, and executive communication.

Skills for Success

- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, Supply Chain, or a related field; MBA or CPA preferred.
- 8+ years of progressive FP&A, finance, accounting, or supply chain finance experience, with meaningful exposure to gross margin, COGS, product cost, inventory, tariffs, duty, freight, or related margin drivers.
- 3+ years of people leadership, project leadership, or cross-functional leadership experience preferred.
- Strong understanding of P&L management, gross margin, standard costing, accruals, reserves, reclasses, allocations, and variance analysis.
- Advanced financial modelling, forecasting, scenario analysis, and executive storytelling skills.
- Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders, simplify complex financial topics, and drive accountability across functions and geographies.
- Experience with SAP, Hyperion, BPC, Power BI, Anaplan, AI-enabled analytics, or similar financial planning and reporting tools preferred.

Senior Manager Success Measures
- Improved global visibility to margin adjustment drivers, risks, and opportunities.
- Increased accuracy and consistency of margin forecasts, bridges, and planning assumptions.
- Stronger governance and standardized reporting treatment across brands, regions, and functions.
- Clearer executive communication and faster alignment on tariff, freight, inventory, overhead, and cost-related margin impacts.
- Effective development and coaching of the Senior Analyst AGM role, with improved analytical depth and decision support.

About VF
VF is a global apparel company connecting people to the lifestyles they cherish through our family of iconic brands. At the heart of our journey lies our purpose: We power movements of sustainable and active lifestyles for the betterment of people and our planet. This is our purpose. It’s the reason we come to work every day. Our purpose unites us and leads us to pursue our goals, together. This is our calling. Learn more at vfc.com

What’s in it For You
We’re in the business of unleashing human potential, driven by the ideas, energy and commitment of our people. That’s why we offer comprehensive benefits that encourage mental, physical and financial well-being for all VF associates. When it comes to benefits, we’re the total package.

- A supportive feedback-based culture where respect and integrity guide us in what we do
- An inclusive international environment where people of diverse backgrounds, lifestyles and nationalities love working together
- Be part of an iconic lifestyle brand in a multi brand, multi countries organization
- On site gym offering health and well-being initiatives
- A discount card with 50% on all VF brands
- Break out areas offering complimentary hot drinks

Free to Be, Inclusion & Diversity
As an equal opportunity employer, we strive to foster a culture of belonging based on respect, connection, openness and authenticity. We are committed to building and maintaining a workplace that celebrates the diversity of our associates, allowing them to bring their authentic selves to work every day.

If you like what you have read and want to join our team then we would like to hear from you!

Title:               Senior Director FP&A APAC Region
Location:       Shanghai
Manager:        Vitto Marin, VP FP&A Brands and Commercial

As the Senior Director, Financial Planning & Analysis, you will serve as a critical partner and co-owner of the APAC regional business P/L, working alongside the senior Commercial leadership team to deliver in-year financial commitments and long-term value creation. This role goes beyond expense management, reporting, and tracking; it is expected to drive the regional business agenda from a finance perspective by translating full value-chain insights into clear actions, priorities, and performance interventions. You will collaborate closely with regional, brand, and cross-functional partners to connect commercial strategy with financial outcomes, identify key business drivers and risks, and enable faster, more effective decision-making across the region. You will lead a team of finance professionals responsible for strengthening financial planning, forecasting, performance management, and decision support , while also driving process, systems, and reporting improvements that provide greater transparency and visibility into current and future financial results.

Regional P/L leadership
- Co-own delivery of the APAC regional P/L with Commercial leadership, using financial analysis to drive business decisions, platform investments , and trade-offs.
- Translate financial insights into clear business actions, partnering with leaders across Brand, Channel, and Marketplace teams to drive revenue, gross margin, operating incomes.
- Challenge assumptions, surface risks and opportunities, and influence cross-functional stakeholders to take timely actions that protect and improve regional finance performance.

Financial Analysis, Budgeting, Forecasting
- Oversee financial reporting, including expense management, of the APAC region in partnership with key stakeholders including the Brand Finance leaders and Commercial leadership teams to drive optimal business results
- Drive the planning, tracking, analysis and delivery of regional platform expenses
- Support the preparation of long-range plan financials, annual budget, and Quarterly Financial Reviews with VF’s ELT
- Ensure all financial information is in a systematic format that all business units can understand and query to ensure comprehensiveness and internal consistency, and submitted as required by the VF Enterprise
- Ensure regional financials are consistently communicated and understood as required across the Brand, Platform and Enterprise
- Lead and direct the creation of relevant performance metrics, scorecards, and processes that represent performance across business units
- Drive and adopt consistent global processes within the region as aligned with the other regional finance leaders and the enterprise.

Strategic Planning, Prioritization, and Communication
- As a key member of the senior Commercial leadership team develop, communicate, execute, and drive the Company's Long-Range Plan (LRP) and yearly goals and objectives, maintaining relevant industry insight, building executable plans, and conducting business with a high degree of business acumen
- Collaborate with leaders across functions in developing commercial plans that align financial targets with business priorities and drive enterprise value.
- Identify and monitor key business drivers and performance metrics across channels, providing insights that inform strategic priorities and enable achievement of regional financial plans.
- Conduct ad hoc financial analysis and provide data-driven insights to support regional decision-making and business performance.

- Consistently support and ensure a reliable and user‐friendly system of information sharing across teams that enables each employee to understand the brand’s LRP, goals and objectives, and to have the necessary information to drive the business plans

Team Leadership
- Lead a team of financial professionals to deliver strong performance results measured by both the Enterprise Finance and Emerging Brands’ annual goals (V2MOM)
- Recruit, mentor, manage and develop talent aligned to VF’s vision, values, and leadership competencies to grow and retain a high performing team with strong engagement measured by monthly office insight (MOI) scores
- Actively participate in VF learning and early career program initiatives to build talent for future succession planning needs as part of the VF Academy learning platform

SKILLS & REQUIREMENTS
- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, or a related field preferred
- Ten to twelve years of progressive experience with five years of managerial experience
- Working knowledge of domestic and international business in Outdoor Industry preferred
- Proficient with software including but not limited to Microsoft Office suite
- Superior oral and written communication skills
- Quality focus in areas of process improvement, metrics, and scorecard expertise required
- Experience with influencing and initiating cultural change, facilitating, and enhancing performance within a cross-functional environment
- Advanced strategic planning and execution skills
- Ability to travel internationally up to 20% of time
